work: Beneath the Surface. Use crisp ink contours and granulating washes throughout the RV Meridian. Let pale paper carry the grey North Atlantic morning, with warmer washes in living spaces and cooler washes in technical rooms. Show maintained fittings with wear at points of contact.

rooms.description: A ribbon of storm windows spans the compact bridge above bolted consoles. Blue navigation, radar and weather displays sit low against the whitecaps. A radio handset hangs beside the log station, with a narrow noticeboard overhead.
rooms.feeling: Exposed to the gale, with the watch still holding steady.

rooms.description: From just above the anti-slip deck, look through teal hose loops toward steel benches, pump housings and a tall sampling rack. Ceiling strips catch droplets on clear sample bottles and cut white streaks across damp metal.
rooms.feeling: Humid and busy, with a pump thrum that seems to come up through the deck.

rooms.description: A wall of square monitors faces the seated viewer, violet plots floating above a straight row of keyboards. Slim computer towers stand beneath the bolted desks. Scientific sketches are tucked into a rail below the screens.
rooms.feeling: Hushed and absorbed, with the rest of the ship briefly out of mind.

rooms.description: Look down on a round bolted table where mismatched mugs ring a coffee pot in an amber pool of light. Beyond the table, a squat refrigerator and a crowded corkboard flank the small galley counter.
rooms.feeling: Familiar warmth and the small comfort of a coffee break.

rooms.description: A pale green examination bed projects into a broad patch of softly lit floor. Flush cabinets have recessed latches. A diagnostic workstation and a narrow report desk with a closed folder fit into opposite corners.
rooms.feeling: Composed and ready, with the stillness of a room between patients.

rooms.description: Four narrow cabin doors line each side of a short passage, their vertical jambs stepping toward a single vanishing point. Warm yellow light spills from the last ajar door and catches the worn handrail and deck seam.
rooms.feeling: Close and private, with the quiet of people sleeping just beyond the bulkhead.

rooms.description: Peer past an empty chair back along a diagonal survey counter. An open laptop glows beneath two offset monitors. Camera lenses, coiled headphones and battery chargers crowd the near edge. Red pins hold thumbnail shot lists.
rooms.feeling: Intimate and restless, with an edit left open mid-thought.

rooms.description: Tall racks of yellow parts bins rise above a scarred vise bench. A caged work light picks out pegboard tools and meter leads. Folded diagrams sit under a steel weight beside a recessed maintenance terminal.
rooms.feeling: Loud and purposeful, with vibration in the bench and every tool within reach.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper sharply in a tailored navy jacket. He leans back, hair swept silver at the temples, an even smile creasing his long face. One open palm sits high beside his lapel as he makes a point.
people.feeling: Polished and personable, with the brisk cadence of someone ready for a decision.

people.description: Tall and straight, she forms a narrow column in a charcoal bridge uniform, elbows tucked and hands clasped behind her back. Window light edges her close-cropped curls and level jaw as she watches just beyond the viewer.
people.feeling: Steady authority, with a deliberate pause before she speaks.

people.description: She turns sideways, narrow shoulders above a fleece that flares at the hips. Teal screen light catches her loose black braid and tired crescent eyes. She glances over with a small smile, cradling a notebook against her waist.
people.feeling: Warm and observant, with fatigue showing around the eyes.

people.description: Stocky and square through the chest, he hunches over a rag, wiping grease from a knuckle. Hard sidelight catches bristly hair, a flattened nose and stubble. Orange stitching traces the boxy shoulders of his coveralls.
people.feeling: Worn down and matter-of-fact, still occupied by the job in his hands.

people.description: Petite and seated, she rounds her shoulders into a gentle arc in a loose sage cardigan, hands folded in her lap. Her chin-length bob frames a heart-shaped face turned toward the person speaking out of frame.
people.feeling: Quiet attention that leaves room for someone to finish speaking.

people.description: Lanky, he pitches into the frame at a slant, a long neck rising from a fitted jacket with a red zipper pull. Wavy hair falls across his forehead. One finger props his sharp cheek as his eyes lift.
people.feeling: Bright, restless curiosity, as if the next question has just occurred to him.
